sentences.en: Chris is very attractive and wealthy, but not very modest.
sentences.zh: 克里斯非常有魅力且富有，但并不很谦虚。

sentences.en: Mr Smith, as I knew him, was a modest man.
sentences.zh: 我认识的史密斯先生是个谦逊的人。

sentences.en: His nephew was brought up to be modest and considerate.
sentences.zh: 他的侄子被教育要谦虚体贴。

senses.zh: limited in size, amount, or scope 适度的，有限的

mnemonic: mod（方式）+est→做事有规矩→礼貌的
